name: M3, Inc.
summary: M3, Inc. provides medical-related services to physicians and other healthcare professionals through the internet. It operates m3.com, a members-only website for providing information, tools, and services for medical professionals; MR-kun which delivers the latest medical information for daily medical practice; QOL-kun, a marketing support service that provides selected information useful for doctors; m3.com CAREER, a physician recruitment and career change support site; and Yakucari, a job search website for pharmacists.
